messages.text: Rename this field to "Your first name" and make this input half as wide

agent.managerSummary:
The first-name input on /contact is now half-width. The label text is owned by your Wix form, so rename it to "Your first name" in the [Wix form builder](https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35).
Dispatched to a new `/contact` lane: rename the field to "Your first name" and halve its width.

lanes.name: /contact
lanes.summary:
Validation passes — no errors related to our changes. The pre-existing warnings are unrelated to this edit.

The width change is applied. For the label rename, the field name "First name" lives in the Wix form builder (dashboard-managed content), so I didn't hard-code it over the `{contact.firstNameD142.label}` binding — the site owner needs to rename it there.

I made that first-name field half as wide. The label text ("First name") comes from your Wix form, not the page code — rename it in the Wix form builder: https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35

AIDITOR_USER_OUTCOME: {"headline":"First-name field is now half as wide; label needs a quick Wix dashboard tweak","bullets":["Shrunk the first-name input on /contact to half its previous width while keeping the rest of the form full-width","The field's label text is owned by your Wix form, so I didn't hard-code it over the dashboard — rename it to \"Your first name\" in the Wix form builder","Opened the form here: https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35","Ran yarn validate — no new errors from this change"]}
